articles.summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) today reported financial and operating results for the period ended September 30, 2022. For the three months ended September 30, 2022 and 2021, Net Income was $0.9 million, or $0.01 per diluted share, compared to Net Income of $4.0 million, or $0.06 per diluted share, respectively.
